args.body: Thank you for your email. Apologies: our summary of 17 Feb said "no issues", but the attached report does record two points: a dog flap installed in the utility room/back door, and sticker marks on the Bedroom 1 wall (tenant to remove and make good). The report does not say who fitted the flap or whether consent was given, and our records show no lock change at all. We are asking the tenant today whether the flap was agreed, who changed the lock, when, and to get a spare front door key to us by 25 Feb. Please tell us if you did not agree the flap or the lock change, and whether you want it reinstated or left. We will update you by 22 Feb. We have also noticed your name differs between our messages (Oliver Bennett / Felix Clarke) and are checking our record.
